narr: Strong thunderstorms producing heavy rain resulted in Flash Flooding across portions of Harris and Austin Counties.
ev: Floodwaters covered SH-288 near Holcombe Blvd in Downtown Houston.
FM 109 with 6 to 8 inches of floodwater near Williams Creek, resulting in the closure of the road.
FM 2754 near Bleiberville was closed due to flooodwaters making the roadway impassable.
FM 2754 near East Mill Creek was impassable due to floodwaters covering the roadway, resulting in the closure of the road.
